hints.title: Uniform Nonzero Target Frequency
hints.text: Notice that in any valid resulting string, every retained character occurs with an identical target frequency.

hints.title: Sequential Alphabet Transition
hints.text: Since operations can shift a letter to the next letter, extra instances of letter i can be converted to letter i + 1.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Formulation
hints.text: For each candidate target frequency from 1 to max count, compute minimal operations using dynamic programming across letters.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through candidate common target frequencies and executes 1D DP across alphabet letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Shifting characters forward creates chained dependencies across all letters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(Sigma) memory storing state transitions across the 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models character shifts into adjacent positions as state transitions in dynamic programming.
